summary:
Frontend regression test of 4 changes. ALL FOUR VERIFIED PASSING. (1) P0 KeyboardAvoidingView CRASH FIXED — logged in mechanicltz@gmail.com → CONTACTS tab → Dealers → Cornwell Tools dealer detail → tapped schedule-TRUCK-ACCOUNT pill. The TRUCK PAYMENT SCHEDULE modal opened cleanly (sched-amount + sched-save + Cancel rendered, 'TRUCK PAYMENT SCHEDULE' title visible). NO red error screen, NO 'KeyboardAvoidingView doesn't exist' text in page body, no pageerror in console. The import added at /app/frontend/src/sections/BalanceSection.tsx:10 resolved the regression. Also verified schedule-CREDIT-ACCOUNT opens the same modal flow (no crash). (2) Inventory single-panel layout VERIFIED — INVENTORY tab now renders ONE single large metal TbvListPanel (CAP.window 9-slice frame, inset marginHorizontal:10) that contains the entire FlatList; the single visible item 'Test Drill' renders as a PLAIN row (rowSkinPlain) with hairline divider styling — NOT a per-item TbvFrame. The empty area inside the panel proves it's the SAME panel (flex:1 child of TbvListPanel). Tapping the row navigates to /tool/{id} successfully. FAB (add-item-fab) remains present and tappable at bottom-right. (3) Detail Summary Header marginHorizontal VERIFIED in code — styles.summaryFrameSkin = { marginHorizontal: 12, marginBottom: 8 } at inventory.tsx:1801, applied to the TbvFrame wrapper at line 929. The summary panel only renders when prefs.show_details_summary && agg exists; this user has it OFF so visual capture not possible, but the inset is correctly applied (left/right gutters match the search bar above). (4) One-tap Email to Insurer VERIFIED — VAULT → Insurance Claims → tapped first claim → scrolled to Reports section → tapped icd-onetap-email button. After ~3s PDF gen, the Email Report v1 modal opened with: icd-email-subject pre-filled 'Insurance Claim — TEST_Dup Source (Copy)' (matches `Insurance Claim — ${title}${claimNo}` template), icd-email-body pre-filled with full polished template ('Hello,

Please find attached the detailed insurance claim report for ...

Policy #: —
Claim #: —
Claim Type: ...
Date of Loss: ...
Net Claimed: $0.00

Please let me know if any additional documentation is needed.

Thank you.'). icd-email-to was empty for this specific claim because it has no insurance.agent_email/adjuster_email saved (data-driven, not a code bug — code at line 100 correctly does `ins.agent_email || ins.adjuster_email || ''`). The per-report mail icon (icd-email-{r.id}) clears emailPrefill via setEmailPrefill(null) before opening modal — verified in code at line 282. NO red error screen, NO crashes on any screen.
action_items: No fixes required — all 4 features ship-ready.

Optional UX polish (not a bug): when the inventory list has only 1-2 items, the single TbvListPanel has a lot of empty space below the last row. This is correct flex:1 fill behavior and matches the design intent (panel fills viewport). If you want to make it look less empty on small accounts, consider showing a soft ghost 'Tap + to add tools' line inside the panel below the last row when displayedTools.length < 3.

Optional verification (not a bug): the icd-onetap-email To field is empty when the claim has no agent_email/adjuster_email saved. This is correct behavior, but you may want to surface a small inline hint in the modal (e.g. 'No insurer email saved — enter one above') so users know why the To field is empty. Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: BalanceSection.tsx:10 — KeyboardAvoidingView now correctly imported from 'react-native'. Used at line 373 inside ScheduleModal. P0 fix verified.

inventory.tsx:1213-1226 — isIndustrial branch correctly wraps FlatList inside ONE TbvListPanel with SKIN.window + CAP.window; FlatList gets styles.listFlexed (flex:1) so virtualization scrolls INSIDE the panel. Single-panel layout confirmed.
inventory.tsx:1168-1187 — when isIndustrial, rows render as plain TouchableOpacity with rowSkinPlain divider styling (no per-item TbvFrame). Non-skinned themes still use ShadowBox.
inventory.tsx:1801 — summaryFrameSkin: { marginHorizontal: 12, marginBottom: 8 } correctly insets the Detail Summary Header from screen edges via styles.summaryFrameSkin at line 929.

insurance-claims/[id].tsx:92-120 — oneTapEmailInsurer correctly: (a) calls renderClaimReportOnly with kind='detailed' + all TOGGLES enabled, (b) builds polished subject `Insurance Claim — ${title}${claimNo}`, (c) builds polished body with Policy/Claim/Type/Date of Loss/Net Claimed, (d) sets selReport and emailPrefill, (e) opens EmailModal. Catch block surfaces errors via Alert.
insurance-claims/[id].tsx:282 — per-report mail icon calls setEmailPrefill(null) BEFORE setEmailOpen(true), so stale one-tap prefill never leaks into per-report email. Correct.

insurance-claims/[id].tsx:455 — EmailModal useEffect resets subject/body from prefill?.subject and prefill?.body on each open; To field auto-populates from ins?.agent_email || ins?.adjuster_email || ''. Correct prefill behavior.

success_rate.backend: skipped (locations seeding curl-verified by main agent)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 changes in iteration 24 verified: (1) P0 dealer Schedule modal no longer crashes (KeyboardAvoidingView imported). (2) Inventory single TbvListPanel layout shipped. (3) Summary header marginHorizontal:12 inset verified in code (not visually since this account has show_details_summary off — to visually test, enable Vault → Preferences → 'Show details summary'). (4) icd-onetap-email button opens Email modal with pre-filled subject + body template (and To from agent_email/adjuster_email if saved). The TEST_Dup Source (Copy) claim used in test had no agent_email saved so To was empty — for a richer demo, test against the 'Shop Fire June 2026' / CLM-1001 claim which has Acme Mutual agent saved.
